newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Minvest shares to be suspended on JSE.
newsitem.headline: Minvest shares to be suspended on JSE.

text.p: Diamond producer Messina Investments Ltd's (Minvest) listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange would be suspended on Friday and was expected to be terminated on February 10 1997.
The move follows the purchase by Barbados-based Becksham Corp of 97.36 percent of Minvest's issued share capital.

In terms of the Companies Act, Becksham was obliged to acquire the offer share held by holders who had not accepted the offer at 500 cents a share as the acceptance by holders was greater than nine-tenths of the offer shares.
Becksham said it expected to acquire the remaining shares subject to the Act.
